tpu0.name: train_p_base_long_s0
cmds: prev=$(find /kaggle/input -maxdepth 7 -type d -path '*checkpoints/p_base_long_s0' | head -1); if [ -n "$prev" ]; then mkdir -p $OUT/checkpoints && cp -r $prev $OUT/checkpoints/; echo resumed from $prev; fi
